findings.evidence: `grep -rn indCharacterSpanInt . --include=*.lean` matches only `Spanning.lean` (def at :294, lemmas at :302, :312, :328, :350, :375) and one module-docstring mention in `Artin.lean:27`. The roadmap item at `TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/InductionRestriction/README.md:395-399` asks for membership 'in the subgroup generated by cyclic-induced characters' — the cyclic instance is exactly that statement and is not made.
findings.fix: Either instantiate it where it earns its keep — state the roadmap's literal phrasing `Nat.card G • f ∈ indCharacterSpanInt k G (fun C ↦ IsCyclic C)` in `Artin.lean` (under `[IsAlgClosed k]` and `isUnit_natCard_subgroup`, via `indVirtualCharacters_eq_indCharacterSpanInt`) — or drop the whole cluster and let `indVirtualCharacters` be the sole integral target, as the PR description says it now is.
findings.issue: `indCharacterSpanInt` and its four lemmas (`ind_ofCharacter_mem_indCharacterSpanInt`, `indCharacterSpanInt_le_iff`, `indCharacterSpanInt_le_indVirtualCharacters`, `indVirtualCharacters_eq_indCharacterSpanInt`) are generalized from the deleted cyclic-specific `indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` to an arbitrary family `P`, but no declaration in the repository ever supplies a `P`. The family parameter never specializes to the target: abstraction with no use. It also leaves a second parallel integral 'induced span' object alongside `indVirtualCharacters`, proved equal to it under mild hypotheses, with only one of the two consumed.

findings.evidence: `Ideal.lean:121-131` and `Spanning.lean:353-369` are the same three-step pattern (`indVirtualCharacters_le_iff`, `virtualCharacters ≤ (…).comap (indClassFunAddHom C)`, `rwa [AddSubgroup.mem_comap, indClassFunAddHom_apply]`); neither cites the other, and `indVirtualCharacters_eq_closure_indCharacter` has no consumer in the repo.
findings.fix: Rewrite the proof to start from `indVirtualCharacters_eq_closure_indCharacter`, reducing the remaining obligation to `indClassFun S V.character ∈ indCharacterSpanInt k G P` for a single `FDRep k S` via `character_mem_closure_irreducibleCharacters`; that is the only step needing `[IsAlgClosed k]` and `hP`.
findings.issue: `indVirtualCharacters_le_indCharacterSpanInt` re-runs the `virtualCharacters_le` / `comap indClassFunAddHom` closure-pushing argument that the same PR already proves in the hypothesis-free general form `indVirtualCharacters_eq_closure_indCharacter` (`Ideal.lean:117`). Two results asserting 'the induced virtual characters are generated by induced characters' land in the PR at different strengths, with the stronger-hypothesis one not derived from the general one.

summary: Hypotheses on the new sharp-Artin and rational-surjectivity theorems are at the right (minimal) level, and the per-subgroup invertibility hypothesis is a genuine generalization. But the `indCharacterSpanInt` cluster is generalized over a family `P` that is never instantiated anywhere, and its comparison lemma re-proves an argument the PR already establishes hypothesis-free in `Ideal.lean`.
